shadows.name: download-hover
shadows.purpose: Neutral elevation on download hover; not a chromatic glow.

motion.name: control-hover
motion.purpose: Existing button hover; disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Primary download
components.description: Release download action with independently darkened action gradient for readable white text.
components.css: .ds-download { display: inline-flex; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1d4ed8 0%, #6d28d9 100%); color: white; padding: 14px 26px; border-radius: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-download:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #3b82f6; outline-offset: 5px; }

narrative.overview: Source-derived record; separate dark download website and native macOS system controls. No new visual world chosen.

rules.name: Surface scope
rules.body: Web literals apply only to index.html; native windows keep system semantics.

dos: Preserve product evidence and platform behavior.
donts: Do not infer runtime acceptance from builds.
